title: Muzi-产品精修3
description: 产品精修，置于纯净的纯白背景上。正视图，平视视角3D宣染，精准还原产品颜色，增强其科技感与高级感。极致展现材质质感(如：描述产品结构)。清除所有指纹、灰尘与瑕疵，让产品看起来薪新、洁净。光线均匀，无明显杂乱阴影，符合电商主图标准，主体突出。
remark: 适合反光面的产品，如杯子，金属类的
notes: Product refinement, placed on a pure white background. Front view, head up view 3D printing, accurately restoring product colors, enhancing its sense of technology and sophistication. Ultimate display of material texture (such as describing product structure). Remove all fingerprints, dust, and blemishes to make the product look new and clean. The lighting is uniform, without obvious messy shadows, in line with the standards of e-commerce main images, and the main body is prominent.
